author: dmaretskyi
principle: Do not use a TypeScript `namespace`; use `export * as Name from './module'` instead, since namespaces are a non-standard TS-only feature.
fix_shape: replace the `namespace` block with a separate module file and re-export it with `export * as X`

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Cache derived values keyed by input identity inside a shared utility so callers don't need to add their own memoization at each call site.
fix_shape: add an internal WeakMap-based cache to the factory function instead of relying on caller-side useMemo

author: dmaretskyi
principle: When an invariant limits a collection to at most one live entry, track that single entry with plain variables instead of a general-purpose Set/Map.
fix_shape: replace the WeakSet/WeakMap with a couple of variables that track the single active entry

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Throw a typed/domain error class rather than a raw `Error`, and extract its construction into a helper function instead of inlining it at the call site.
fix_shape: define or reuse a specific error class and a small factory function for the error message

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Avoid recreating an expensive resource (e.g. a query) on every reactive recomputation; construct it once and reuse it.
fix_shape: hoist the expensive construction outside the reactive recomputation closure

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Dereference a WeakRef once outside a lazily re-invoked closure when the referenced value's lifetime should be tied to the closure's own lifetime.
fix_shape: move the deref outside the closure so the surrounding scope holds a strong reference for as long as it is alive

author: dmaretskyi
principle: A long-lived registry/cache must have an eviction or cleanup mechanism rather than growing unbounded.
fix_shape: add cleanup logic (e.g. tied to GC via WeakRef/FinalizationRegistry, or explicit removal) so entries are removed when no longer needed

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Avoid recreating an expensive resource (e.g. a query) on every reactive recomputation; construct it once outside the recomputation closure and reuse it.
fix_shape: move the expensive call outside the Atom.make/recomputation closure

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Dereference a WeakRef once outside a lazily re-invoked closure when the referenced value's lifetime should be tied to the closure's own lifetime.
fix_shape: move the deref outside the closure so the surrounding scope holds a strong reference for as long as it is alive

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Prefer the framework's built-in lifecycle/cleanup mechanism over maintaining a separate hand-rolled registry for the same purpose.
fix_shape: rely on the library's automatic cleanup (e.g. Atom.family's FinalizationRegistry) instead of implementing a custom registry

author: dmaretskyi
principle: When converting a previously-synchronous side effect to an awaited async call, check whether other code depending on that side effect can run before the await resolves.
fix_shape: ensure the dependent state update happens before the await point, or guard against interleaving

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Use a standard platform API (e.g. crypto.randomUUID()) for generating opaque identifiers instead of a project-specific helper, when no special property of that helper is needed.
fix_shape: replace the custom ID-generation helper with the standard platform function

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Consolidate multiple parallel lookup maps keyed by different identifiers into one map when a single key can serve every case.
fix_shape: build one combined map instead of maintaining separate maps per key type

author: dmaretskyi
principle: A reactive object graph must forbid cycles and multiple inbound ownership pointers to the same nested record so reactivity scope stays well-defined; define object boundaries via schema rather than allowing ad hoc sharing.
fix_shape: restrict nested-object assignment to a single owner and reject cyclic or shared-record structures instead of allowing them silently

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Track an object's ownership directly on the object itself (a hidden marker) rather than in a separate side-table, and centralize the associated behavior in one place instead of spreading it across each nested object.
fix_shape: attach a hidden symbol/property recording the owner instead of maintaining a parallel WeakMap, routed through one central mechanism

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Every package.json export/import entrypoint must be registered in the build config (moon.yml) or the build will miss it.
fix_shape: add the new entrypoint path to the package's moon.yml compile configuration

author: dmaretskyi
principle: A package's own build/bundler config should not try to resolve its own subpath imports internally; leave them external for the consuming code's build to resolve.
fix_shape: keep the subpath import external in the bundler config rather than adding a custom resolution branch

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Document what an opaque handle/reference actually points to, and use precise types instead of a loose object/any, so its semantics aren't left to inference.
fix_shape: add JSDoc clarifying what the value represents and tighten the type

author: dmaretskyi
principle: When enforcing a single-ownership invariant, add an explicit check that rejects reassigning an already-owned value rather than silently overwriting the owner.
fix_shape: add a guard/invariant that throws (or copies) when a value already has a different owner

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Trim exploratory/uncertain comments before landing; a comment should state the settled reasoning, not leftover speculation.
fix_shape: shorten the comment to state the final decision and remove rhetorical questions/musing

author: dmaretskyi
principle: When adding a feature analogous to an existing one, model it after the existing implementation (including its test coverage) for consistency.
fix_shape: mirror the existing analogous feature's implementation and test pattern for the new one

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Name test files in lowercase (kebab-case) rather than capitalized, matching the project's file-naming convention.
fix_shape: rename the file to lowercase

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Use the SQL client's typed builder helpers (e.g. an `IN`-clause helper) instead of hand-building raw/unsafe SQL strings for parameterized queries.
fix_shape: replace the manual placeholder-string construction and unsafe SQL call with the builder's dedicated helper

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Use the SQL client's typed builder helpers instead of hand-building raw SQL strings for parameterized queries.
fix_shape: replace the manual SQL string construction with the query builder's helper

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Merge near-duplicate methods that differ only by a boolean/flag condition into a single parameterized method instead of maintaining two copies.
fix_shape: combine the two methods into one, adding a parameter to select the varying behavior

author: mykola-vrmchk
principle: Name a general-purpose helper after its actual general behavior, not after the first narrow use case it was written for.
fix_shape: rename the method to reflect its broader purpose

author: mykola-vrmchk
principle: Avoid issuing one query per item in a loop (N+1); accept an array parameter and perform the work as a single batched query instead.
fix_shape: change the method to accept an array of ids and run one query with an IN clause instead of Promise.all over separate queries

author: mykola-vrmchk
principle: Extract a complex inline block of logic into a named, documented function so its purpose is clear rather than left as an unlabeled block.
fix_shape: pull the logic into a separate function with a doc comment describing what it does
